subject: SOC 2 Type II kickoff: report delivery, bridge-letter options, and minimal evidence bundle
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novapay.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: NovaPay Security Team <security@novapay.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + bridge letter and minimal evidence list

Hi Priya,

We're kicking off our vendor risk review for the next quarter and need Redwood's SOC 2 Type II materials to complete our audit intake. Specifically: 1) a copy of the Type II report covering the most recent audit period, 2) any bridge letter / interim coverage note you have, and 3) a short guidance list (what's the minimal set) we can expect to receive (control narratives, sample logs, telemetry snippets, evidence hashes, etc.).

Can you confirm the audit period covered by your latest Type II and whether you offer a standard bridge letter when the report period doesn't fully overlap our cutover? Also, what secure transfer methods do you support (SFTP/SharePoint/secure Drive/AS2)? We have a tight timeline — target completion by Oct 15 — so any quick-reply templates would help.

I've attached our SIG-lite for context and marked the sections we flag as high priority.

Thanks,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Lead, Vendor Security
NovaPay
attachments: novapay-sig-questionnaire.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novapay.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + bridge letter and minimal evidence list

Hi Liam — thanks for the clear ask and the SIG attachment. Quick answers up front: we can provide the most recent SOC 2 Type II report, a standard bridge-letter template (for audit-window mismatches), and a compact "what-to-share" checklist. Secure transfer options we support: SFTP (one-time account), SharePoint secure link, and an encrypted Drive folder (access-controlled).

To make this fast, here's what we typically include as the minimal evidence bundle for an initial intake: 
- SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) + management assertion
- Bridge letter (if the audit window doesn't align)
- Control narrative summary (4–6 pages) covering logical access, change control, incident response, and logging
- Sample telemetry/log snippet (redacted) — typically a 24–48 hour window of aggregated auth/log events
- Screenshot proofs or telemetry hashes for retention / backup configs
- Certificate of encryption / KMS config summary (1 pager)

I've attached a short "SOC2 delivery options" PDF that lays out transfer methods and redaction rules. If you think you need full evidence sets (raw logs / longer periods), let us know and we can scope that separately — it often requires a non-disclosure addendum.

Quick question: what exact audit period do you need covered (start/end)? Our latest Type II covers 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30; a bridge letter can cover interim controls after that date through the current date.

Below are two one-line reply templates you can paste into your tracker: 
- "Please share Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report (2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30), bridge letter, control narrative summary, and a redacted 48-hour telemetry sample via SFTP."
- "Acceptable transfer methods: SFTP (preferred), SharePoint secure link, or encrypted Drive folder; requestor will confirm preferred path."

I'll loop in Dylan from Ops (for log samples) and Monica from Security (for bridge letters) to keep this moving.

Best,
Priya
Priya Natarajan
Vendor Security Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: soc2-delivery-options.pdf (pdf)
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novapay.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: NovaPay Security Team <security@novapay.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T11:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + bridge letter and minimal evidence list

Thanks Priya — that helps a lot. Confirming audit window we need coverage for: 2026-01-01 through 2026-09-30 (our fiscal period). Your Type II covers through 2026-06-30, so the bridge letter should cover 2026-07-01 to 2026-09-30.

We'd prefer SFTP for the initial transfer and are fine with redacted telemetry (please remove IPs and user identifiers). Also attaching a short vendor intake spreadsheet with the fields our GRC tooling expects — if you can pre-fill the minimal items (report name, period, MD5/sha256 for files, transfer method) that's ideal.

Two quick asks: 1) can you include an example of the telemetry snippet format (JSON or CSV) so we can map it into our tools, and 2) are you able to provide a signed bridge letter (PDF) or is it unsigned by default?

Appreciate the templates.

—Liam
attachments: novapay-intake.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + bridge letter and minimal evidence list

Hi Liam — Dylan from Ops here. Per Priya's note: we can provide a redacted telemetry snippet in JSON with these fields: timestamp, event_type, outcome, resource, region. Attached is a tiny sample file illustrating the format (sample-telemetry-snippet.json). We will remove personal identifiers and IPs.

On bridge letters: Monica will provide a signed PDF by default when requested by a customer; if you need additional statements beyond the standard template, we can review case-by-case.

Next steps: 
1) Please confirm SFTP hostname preference (we can either initiate a one-time account or you can provide a drop location).
2) We'll prepare: Type II PDF, signed bridge letter (covering 2026-07-01 to 2026-09-30), control narrative summary, and the redacted telemetry snippet (JSON). Expect a delivery note with MD5/SHA256 hashes and file manifest.

I'll upload the manifest and files to the secure Drive folder and share a link when ready: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRedwood-SOC2

Regards,
